description: Asks ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity one question with web search on, and says whether each cites the site, where, whether it names it without citing it, and who it cites instead. Paid in mttr credits; mttr_citations shows the price and the balance first. Only the assistants mttr is connected to are asked: while none is, it answers 503 and costs nothing.
